mechanism: Lisdexamfetamine may increase renal perfusion pressure and amikacin is nephrotoxic with potential for additive renal dysfunction; amikacin is ototoxic and sympathomimetics may increase auditory toxicity risk.
action: Monitor renal function (serum creatinine, BUN) and audiometry during concurrent use; consider alternative antibiotics if renal impairment present; ensure adequate hydration.
